lessons: The work itself passed: ruff check, ruff format --check, uv lock --check and pytest (3076 passed) all exited 0. Only diff_budget failed, at 43 files against the 30-file limit; 299 inserted lines is well under 1500. So split by file count, without changing the approach.

Divide the ticket's fence into stems of at most 30 files each. The run touched 13 files under chupa/ and eval/, 28 under tests/, plus pyproject.toml and uv.lock. For example, one stem fixes the tests/ findings by hand, and a later stem adds the pyproject config and fixes chupa/ and eval/.

Each stem must state acceptance criteria it can meet alone. 'uv run ruff check .' exiting 0 belongs only in the stem that adds the [tool.ruff] config, after the other stems' fixes have merged. Use depends only where a stem needs another stem's merged code.

Keep the change from attempt 2: tests that used validate_ticket through an unused chupa.stages import now import it from chupa.tickets. Put this change in the same stem as the F401 removals in those test files.
